title: Type \(D_9\) absolute order 的 normalized flow
confidence_basis: The unique primary exact rational certificate is frozen by SHA-256 and passes its fail-closed verifier.
A separately written standard-library verifier imported no discovery or primary-verifier code, reconstructed the full signed-permutation quotient, and reported fatal=0 and major=0.
All nine targeted corruptions were rejected, and every one of the nine adjacent-rank layers was checked with exact rational and denominator-cleared integer conservation.
Carter's reflection-length theorem was checked at Lemma 2, journal page 3, and its applicability to exactly the 72 D9 reflections was independently audited.
Two dated novelty searches, official citation verification, a clean LaTeX build, and a six-page visual PDF audit passed.
Confidence is not set to 100 because no proof-assistant formalization was produced and bounded public searches cannot exclude private or unindexed prior work.
summary: Abs(D_9) admits a normalized flow with unit vertex weights. The exact finite theorem is certified by 284 nonzero rational B_9-orbit flow totals and two independent fail-closed verifiers.
evidence: Referee reconstruction: 150 orbits, 609 supported orbit pairs, 284 positive flows, 3,344,302,080 covers, all nine layers verified.
Final referee severity: fatal 0; major 0; local 0; expository 0.
